display.purpose: The winner's name and the reveal's headlines on the big screen (stage display, 10.4u; the beat is 11.4u).

headline.purpose: A longer winner's name on the big screen (stage headline, 8u).

title.purpose: The category name: on the big screen (stage title, 6.4u), in the run view, and on phones (30px), where the outcome headings take the same size.

label.purpose: Buttons, stage labels, nomination names (20px on a phone tile, 18px under a photo).

shadows.name: shadow-soft
shadows.purpose: Tiles, cards, the room code chip; in the host views the room-code card, the category cards, the Run the Show pill and the running order's current row.

shadows.name: shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: The QR code, the live count, the main button (the run view's next-step pill), the phone's vote-in badge.

shadows.name: shadow-bar-lift
shadows.purpose: The phone's pinned action bar, with a 2px secondary-coloured top edge, only while tiles run on under it; flat at the end of the list. Fades in and out over 0.3s.

motion.name: ease-out-soft
motion.purpose: Columns rising at the reveal (1.2s each, one every 0.9s), the crown's widening and the name landing (0.7s).

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Small bounces: the vote-in badge, the live count's hop with each vote.

motion.name: podium-tense
motion.purpose: The leader's shiver just under second place, for 1.6s before the beat. Not with reduced motion.

motion.name: count-hop
motion.value: scale 1 to 1.06 (at 40%) to 1, 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 1.6, 0.4, 1), Web Animations on the count circle
motion.purpose: The live count's hop with each new vote. Not with reduced motion.

motion.name: shape-bob
motion.purpose: The quiet screens' shape marks bobbing, each a beat behind the last (0, -0.9s, -1.7s). Only with motion allowed.

motion.name: vote-in
motion.purpose: The phone's vote-in badge arriving. No zoom with reduced motion.

motion.name: phone-scene
motion.purpose: A new category arriving on the phone; its stages change in place. A fade only with reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one next step on a screen: vote, open or close voting, reveal. In the host views the Button sizes `pillLg` (56px, the run view's next step, Lift) and `pill` (48px, Run the Show, Soft); one solid pill per host screen (The One Pill Rule).

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: The `quiet` Button variant, a bordered ghost: secondary steps such as taking an award off the big screen, Open Big Screen, the dashed Add category, the danger zone's buttons.

components.name: Card
components.description: A surface on the stage for forms and grouped content.

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet everywhere, never the action colour: header links, icon actions; a delete icon turns destructive on hover.

components.name: Quiet Danger Button
components.description: The danger zone's Reset and Delete: the `quiet` variant whose border and text turn destructive on hover; the confirm dialog keeps the solid red.
components.css: .ds-danger{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:24px;border:2px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--destructive,#ff6b8a) 40%,transparent);border-radius:24px}.ds-danger-btn{height:40px;padding:0 16px;border:2px solid var(--border,#33316a);border-radius:9999px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted-foreground,#bab8e6);font:600 .875rem Fredoka,ui-rounded,system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .2s,color .2s,background .2s}.ds-danger-btn:hover{border-color:var(--destructive,#ff6b8a);color:var(--destructive,#ff6b8a);background:var(--accent,#4a4892)}.ds-danger-btn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ring,#ff7a5c);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Category Type Badge
components.description: A neutral pill (muted fill, foreground text) naming the category's type; only its Duotone icon takes a mark colour (Image mark-2, Ranking mark-3, Aggregate mark-1).
components.html: Ranking (Top 3)

components.name: Stage Stepper
components.description: The run view's stages for the award on its card: done steps in the muted fill, the current one a 15% action-colour tint with an inset ring (never a fill), steps to come quieter.
components.css: .ds-steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px;width:520px;margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;font:600 .875rem Fredoka,ui-rounded,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-steps li{padding:10px 12px;border-radius:14px;text-align:center;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--muted,#1f1e4a) 60%,transparent);color:var(--muted-foreground,#bab8e6)}.ds-steps li.done{background:var(--muted,#1f1e4a);color:var(--foreground,#fff)}.ds-steps li[aria-current]{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--primary,#ff7a5c) 15%,transparent);color:var(--primary,#ff7a5c);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb,var(--primary,#ff7a5c) 50%,transparent)}

components.name: Running Order
components.description: The run view's muted aside (panel corners, 24px): each award in a 14px inner row with its mark-coloured shape marker and stage; the current row lifted onto the card colour with the Soft shadow, its stage in the action colour; an aggregate waiting on its sources says "Waits for its awards".
components.html:
Running order

  1. Best Desk SnackDone
  2. Best Dance MoveVoting
  3. Champion of ChampionsWaits for its awards
components.css: .ds-order{width:340px;padding:16px;border-radius:24px;background:var(--muted,#1f1e4a);color:var(--foreground,#fff);font-family:Fredoka,ui-rounded,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-order h3{margin:0;padding:4px 8px 8px;color:var(--muted-foreground,#bab8e6);font-size:.875rem;font-weight:600}.ds-order ol{display:grid;gap:4px;margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}.ds-order li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:14px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s}.ds-order li:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--card,#2e2c66) 60%,transparent)}.ds-order li span{flex:1}.ds-order em{font-style:normal;font-size:.75rem;color:var(--muted-foreground,#bab8e6)}.ds-order li[aria-current]{background:var(--card,#2e2c66);box-shadow:0 6px 20px var(--shadow-color,rgb(0 0 0/.4));font-weight:600}.ds-order li[aria-current] em{color:var(--primary,#ff7a5c);font-weight:600}

components.name: Input
components.description: Text fields such as the room code and show name.

components.name: Nomination Tile
components.description: One choice in the voter's radio group: card-coloured, 20px corners, a round tick ring; the pick takes the action colour, never the winner colour. A ranking tile shows its place; a vote already in wears a "Your vote" chip while changing.
components.css: .ds-noms{display:grid;gap:12px;width:340px}.ds-nom{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;min-height:64px;padding:12px 18px;border:0;border-radius:20px;background:var(--card,#2e2c66);color:var(--card-foreground,#fff);font:600 1.25rem/1.25 Fredoka,ui-rounded,system-ui,sans-serif;text-align:left;box-shadow:0 6px 20px var(--shadow-color,rgb(0 0 0/.4));cursor:pointer;transition:transform .2s,background-color .2s,color .2s}.ds-nom i{margin-left:auto;flex:none;display:grid;place-items:center;width:28px;height:28px;box-sizing:border-box;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--muted-foreground,#bab8e6) 70%,transparent)}.ds-nom[aria-checked=true],.ds-nom[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--primary,#ff7a5c);color:var(--primary-foreground,#16153a)}.ds-nom[aria-checked=true] i{border-color:var(--primary-foreground,#16153a);background:var(--primary-foreground,#16153a)}.ds-nom[aria-checked=true] i::after{content:"";width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--primary,#ff7a5c)}.ds-nom b{margin-left:auto;display:grid;place-items:center;width:52px;height:36px;border-radius:9999px;background:var(--primary-foreground,#16153a);color:var(--primary,#ff7a5c);font-size:1rem;font-weight:700}.ds-nom-yours{margin-left:auto;padding:2px 10px;border-radius:9999px;background:var(--muted,#1f1e4a);color:var(--muted-foreground,#bab8e6);font-size:.875rem}.ds-nom-yours+i{margin-left:0}.ds-nom:active{transform:scale(.98)}.ds-nom:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring,#ff7a5c);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Pinned Action
components.description: The phone's one action: full width, 60px, at the bottom in thumb reach, naming the pick; quiet while it can't send, saying what's missing.
components.css: .ds-pin{display:grid;gap:12px;width:340px;padding:16px 20px 20px;background:var(--background,#16153a);border-top:2px solid var(--secondary,#45438a);box-shadow:0 -14px 28px -10px var(--shadow-color,rgb(0 0 0/.4))}.ds-pin-btn{height:60px;width:100%;border:0;border-radius:9999px;background:var(--primary,#ff7a5c);color:var(--primary-foreground,#16153a);font:700 1.25rem Fredoka,ui-rounded,system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 18px 44px var(--shadow-color,rgb(0 0 0/.4));white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .15s}.ds-pin-btn:active{transform:scale(.98)}.ds-pin-btn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ring,#ff7a5c);outline-offset:3px}.ds-pin-btn:disabled{background:var(--muted,#1f1e4a);color:var(--muted-foreground,#bab8e6);box-shadow:none;cursor:default}.ds-pin-quiet{justify-self:center;padding:8px;border:0;background:none;color:var(--primary,#ff7a5c);font:600 1.125rem Fredoka,ui-rounded,system-ui,sans-serif;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px;cursor:pointer}.ds-pin-quiet:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring,#ff7a5c);border-radius:6px}

components.name: Vote Outcome
components.description: "Your vote is in": a 128px action-colour badge with a Bold check, the vote named, and a quiet way to change it. Quiet screens carry the shape marks instead, in the mark colours (mark-1 to mark-3), never the winner colour.
components.html:
Your vote is in

You voted for The Worm. Watch the big screen for the results.
components.css: .ds-out{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;width:340px;text-align:center;font-family:Fredoka,ui-rounded,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--foreground,#fff)}.ds-out-badge{display:grid;place-items:center;width:128px;height:128px;margin-bottom:28px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--primary,#ff7a5c);color:var(--primary-foreground,#16153a);box-shadow:0 18px 44px var(--shadow-color,rgb(0 0 0/.4))}.ds-out h2{margin:0;font-size:1.875rem;font-weight:700;line-height:1.25}.ds-out p{max-width:20rem;margin:12px 0 0;color:var(--muted-foreground,#bab8e6);font-size:1.125rem;line-height:1.375}.ds-out strong{color:var(--foreground,#fff)}.ds-out-quiet{margin-top:24px;padding:8px;border:0;background:none;color:var(--primary,#ff7a5c);font:600 1.125rem Fredoka,ui-rounded,system-ui,sans-serif;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px;cursor:pointer}.ds-out-quiet:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring,#ff7a5c);border-radius:6px}.ds-marks{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:12px;margin-top:40px}@keyframes ds-bob{50%{transform:translateY(-6px)}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-marks svg{animation:ds-bob 2.6s ease-in-out infinite}.ds-marks svg:nth-child(2){animation-delay:-.9s}.ds-marks svg:nth-child(3){animation-delay:-1.7s}}

components.name: Live Count
components.description: The big screen's vote count during voting: a circle in the action colour (never gold), hopping with each vote.

components.name: Room Code Chip
components.description: The site's address and the room code, small in the big screen's top right once an award is on.

components.name: Progress Dots
components.description: Which award of the show is on the big screen: a dot for each (up to twelve), the current one a pill in the action colour, and "Award N of M".

narrative.overview:
An awards night run from a laptop, voted on from phones and revealed on whatever screen the room has. The fun lives in how the results arrive, in the timing and the words, and in a light touch everywhere else: rounded, friendly and clear from across the room, polished the way Nintendo, NYT Games or a Kahoot round is. It is built to be fun on the ninth award of the night, not just the first, so nothing is a gimmick that wears thin: no costume theme, no novelty textures, no mascot.

One system at three volumes. The big screen is loudest: display type, the podium race and confetti. The voter's phone is medium: big tap targets and one moment of delight when a vote is in. Host views are quiet: the same colours and type, with nothing playful in the controls. The show screens carry no AwardBro branding; they belong to the people in the room.

There are two themes from one set of roles. **Night** (dark) is the default, because most shows happen in the evening in a dim room. **Paper** (light) is the same system on warm paper for daytime rooms and bright projectors. The big screen's theme is set by the host per show (Night by default, Paper on the manage page's Night/Paper switch), and the screen follows it live; phones and host views follow the device setting, with an override. On the vote page, the run view and the manage page (and their password form) that override is the theme toggle in the header, remembered on the device (`localStorage`); until the person picks one, the page follows `prefers-color-scheme` live, and an inline script (`<DeviceThemeScript />`, rendered by the vote page and by the manage layout for every host view) sets the theme before the first paint so a light device never flashes dark. It is the device's theme, separate from the big screen's per-show one. A page puts its theme on `<html>` (`data-theme="light"` for Paper, nothing for Night), so dialogs, tooltips and toasts, which render outside the page, follow it too.
keyCharacteristics: Rounded everything: Fredoka type, pill buttons, rounded-top podium columns.
Solid, saturated colour that survives a washed-out projector; no glows or gradients.
Results as a podium race: columns rise, each nomination in its own colour, the leader stalls, the winner turns gold and lands.
A small shape set (circle, triangle, squiggle) as markers, the quiet screens' mark and confetti, nothing more.
Soft coloured shadows; never hard offset shadows.

rules.name: The Gold Is Earned Rule
rules.body: The winner colour belongs to the winner alone: never a button, never a runner-up's column. Nothing else on the reveal is gold (or Podium Coral on Paper), so the moment it appears, the room knows. Off the reveal it doesn't appear at all: no shape mark, badge or host control takes the theme's winner colour (confetti, which falls only at a win, is the one exception).

rules.name: The Seeded Colour Rule
rules.body: Column colours look random but aren't: they are shuffled with the award as the seed, so the big screen, the host's laptop and every reload show the same colours. Up to seven nominations never repeat a colour; beyond seven, colours repeat but never side by side.

rules.name: The One Pill Rule
rules.body: A host screen has one solid action-colour shape: its main pill (the run view's next step, the manage page's Run the Show). Everything else is muted until hovered; where a state needs the action colour, such as the stepper's current step, it is a 15% tint with an inset ring, not a fill.

rules.name: The Projector Rule
rules.body: Colour is solid and saturated. No tints below 20% contrast, no gradients and no glow: a cheap projector washes out the subtle and keeps the bold.

rules.name: The Stage Unit Rule
rules.body: Everything on the big screen is sized in stage units: type from the `text-stage-*` scale, spacing from Tailwind's scale (which counts in half-units there), anything else as a multiple of `u`. Never a fixed pixel or rem size on the big screen, or it breaks on the next screen size.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: No small uppercase label above a heading. Context such as "Award 4 of 9" sits beside the progress dots; "And the winner is…" is a timed beat of its own, not a label.

rules.name: The Overscan Rule
rules.body: Some TVs crop the outer 5% of the picture, so nothing that has to be read sits there: the margins clear it, and a column can run off the bottom edge only because its count and name sit at its top, above the floor (24u).

rules.name: The Thumb Reach Rule
rules.body: A phone screen has one action, pinned full width at the bottom within thumb reach, and it names what it sends ("Vote for The Worm", "Submit my top 3"). Every other way out ("Change my vote", "Keep my vote", "Start again") is a quiet text button.

rules.name: The No Hard Offset Rule
rules.body: Never a solid offset shadow (the sticker or Memphis look). Shadows blur.

rules.name: The Duotone Moment Rule
rules.body: Bold for controls; Duotone (`weight="duotone"`) only for the category-type badges. A voter's vote confirmation is a Bold check on an action-colour badge, and the quiet screens (waiting, voting closed, an aggregate) carry the shape set as their mark, not an icon. Its second layer is the text colour at 20%, so it works in both themes without a token of its own. Never Duotone on a button.

dos: **Do** keep the action colour for actions and the winner colour for the winner alone.
**Do** write copy that says what happens next ("Watch the big screen for the results.").
**Do** respect `prefers-reduced-motion`: show the end state at once.
**Do** check every text pair against both themes; body text stays at 4.5:1 or more.
**Do** size everything on the big screen in stage units, and keep what must be read clear of the outer 5%.
**Do** give each host screen one solid action-colour pill; tint, don't fill, any other state that needs the action colour.
donts: **Don't** put AwardBro branding on the big screen or the vote page.
**Don't** use hard offset shadows, gradients or glows.
**Don't** add themed decoration (envelopes, stamps, tickets, textures): it gets old by the third award.
**Don't** put a small uppercase label above a heading.
**Don't** show a destructive action solid red at rest: it turns red on hover, and only its confirm dialog's button is solid.
